surface: Release PR validation, merge-triggered tagging workflow, release doctrine, release issue template
summary: Automatically tag merged Release PR commits from GitHub Actions after validating synced version files and remote tag availability as a patch-level release workflow improvement.
migration_impact: Repositories adopting this change should update Release PR automation so the versioned release artifact and repository version files stay in sync before merge. The merge workflow now owns initial tag creation, while finalize remains responsible for downstream triggers and rollover/repair.
migration_guidance: 1. Update Release PR CI to resolve the intended release version from synced repository version files plus `.agentic/releases/vX.Y.Z/release.json`.
2. Fail Release PRs when version files disagree or when `refs/tags/vX.Y.Z` already exists on the remote.
3. Update the release workflow to tag `pull_request.merge_commit_sha` after a merged Release PR to `main`, succeeding idempotently when the tag already points at that commit.
4. Update release ceremony docs and templates so Release PR merge creates the tag automatically and finalize only handles downstream triggers / rollover.
agent_notes: Use the release artifact and synced repository version surfaces as the authoritative release version. This fragment is intentionally patch-level: it improves release ceremony automation without changing the product's semver surface. The merge workflow should refuse to retag a different commit and should treat an existing tag on the same merge commit as a no-op.
